name: Projected Tetrahedra
definition: A fast algorithm for unstructured volume visualization that generates triangles which may be rendered by hardware acceleration. It is a view-dependent technique that needs to sort the tetrahedra before rendering.
summary: Projected Tetrahedra is a GPU-based volume rendering technique that projects unstructured tetrahedral cells as triangle fans, using texture-based storage to minimize memory and avoid complex auxiliary data structures.
